title: SharePoint: tenant-wide usage statistics for SharePoint agents
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and documents the existing Agent Insights control. However, it describes the planned statistics as accessible only to administrators, which the roadmap does not establish; the access restrictions remain unpublished. The command reference also retains a rollout caveat that differs from the report guide.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to aggregate SharePoint agents' usage statistics across all SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents a report on agent access across SharePoint and OneDrive sites.
claims.quote: The agent access insights report provides SharePoint administrators with rich information on how the agents access content across all SharePoint and OneDrive sites in your organization.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents SharePoint agent usage in Copilot.
claims.quote: You can see which agents both licensed and unlicensed Microsoft Copilot users use across Declarative, SharePoint, and Custom engine agents.

claims.claim: The checked sources do not explicitly identify the documented reports as roadmap item 480729.
claims.quote: Searched: '480729 SharePoint agent usage statistics tenant admin report default rollout roles licensing'; read roadmap and Learn insights-on-sharepoint-agents, insights-on-agent-access, monitor-agent-usage, and microsoft-365-copilot-agents-new; none explicitly identifies item 480729.

claims.claim: Learn says Microsoft is prioritising richer analytics across Copilot Analytics dashboard, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, SharePoint Advanced Management and SharePoint Online in the coming months.
claims.quote: Microsoft is prioritizing delivering even richer analytics across Copilot Analytics dashboard, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, SharePoint Advanced Management, and SharePoint Online in the coming months.

claims.claim: The existing Agent Insights report covers recently created agents across all SharePoint and OneDrive sites in the organisation.
claims.quote: The insights report on agents in SharePoint provides SharePoint administrators with rich information on the recently created agents across all SharePoint sites and OneDrive sites within their organization.

claims.claim: The Agent Insights report is based on audit data for file creation and renaming.
claims.quote: The insights report is based on the Microsoft audit data logged for the agents created in SharePoint through the FileCreated and FileRenamed events.

claims.claim: The documented created-agent report reports agent inventory rather than interaction frequency.
claims.quote: CopilotAgentsOnSites: Provides the name of all the agents currently available on all sites. ... TopSites: Provides a list of 100 sites with the number of agents available on each site.

claims.claim: The Agent Insights report is reached in SharePoint admin center through Reports > Agent Insights.
claims.quote: Sign in to the SharePoint admin center ... In the navigation pane, expand Reports and then select Agent Insights.

claims.claim: Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays 28 generates the existing Agent Insights report for 28 days through SharePoint Online Management Shell.
claims.quote: For example, to generate a report for the past 28 days, run the command: Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays <28>
claims.fix: Add to the control note: 'The report guide documents this control as available, while the cmdlet reference still says the associated feature will be rolling out soon.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoft.online.sharepoint.powershell/start-spocopilotagentinsightsreport, which also confirms that ReportPeriodInDays accepts 28.

claims.claim: Generating and viewing the existing report in Management Shell requires the organisation to have the SharePoint Advanced Management add-on SKU or a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: To generate and view these reports, ensure the organization has the SharePoint Advanced Management add-on SKU or Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: Without a SharePoint Advanced Management licence, the report experience asks the administrator to enable data collection first.
claims.quote: If you don't have a Microsoft SharePoint Advanced Management license, you're asked to enable data collection so that relevant audit data is collected to build the report.

claims.claim: SharePoint agent usage can incur pay-as-you-go charges.
claims.quote: To use pay-as-you-go billing, you need to first set up SharePoint agents as a resource in Azure. That resource is used whenever a user without a Microsoft Copilot license uses a SharePoint agent.

claims.claim: SharePoint agent usage charges appear under the Copilot Studio meter on the invoice.
claims.quote: Charges of SharePoint agent usage appear under the Copilot Studio meter in your invoice. However, in Microsoft cost management, you can see a detailed breakdown by feature, including SharePoint agents.
